harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created “Fleet Internal CA” on node1, issued a node2 certificate with DNS and managed-IP SANs, installed the CA in both system trust stores, and configured node2 to serve trusted HTTPS on TCP/8443. Both nodes retained RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8. Sequential restart testing confirmed persistence and recovery.
actions_performed: Generated and retained the CA key and certificate on node1.
Issued node2’s TLS certificate for DNS:node2 and IP:10.100.183.11.
Installed the CA anchor on node1 and node2.
Configured an enabled systemd HTTPS service on node2 and permitted TCP/8443 through firewalld.
Verified trusted HTTPS by DNS name and managed IP.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Create Fleet Internal CA and issue node2 TLS certificate
evidence.summary: The leaf verifies against the CA; the CA is marked CA:TRUE and the leaf contains DNS:node2 and IP:10.100.183.11.

evidence.requirement: Install CA as a trusted system authority on both nodes
evidence.summary: Both nodes validate node2.crt through their system trust stores and report the same Fleet Internal CA fingerprint.

evidence.requirement: Serve trusted HTTPS on node2 port 8443
evidence.summary: The service is enabled and active, listens on 0.0.0.0:8443, survives restart, and returns its expected response with successful DNS and IP certificate validation.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 before and after configuration and restarts.
Captured healthy baseline boot ID 9feeb0bb…, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, proved the new boot ID 59a230db…, and verified CA key, certificate data, trust, and HTTPS access recovered.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID bef0e5ec…, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, proved the new boot ID 08ff6841…, and verified the service, firewall, listener, key, certificates, trust, and HTTPS response recovered.
